title: Bottle on a Kitchen Counter
tests: Tests replacing a product photo's setting while preserving the actual product and making its placement believable.

faults.what: The bottle is tiny and floats in the upper-right corner against the cabinets instead of standing on the counter; there is no contact shadow.
The bottle's drastic reduction in size makes its original visible details indistinct and fails to preserve it as the product subject.

judge.summary: The square image shows a tidy modern kitchen and light stone counter, but the bottle is a tiny floating object in the upper-right corner.

must_haves.item: The same matte black bottle is recognizable, with its shape and visible details preserved.
must_haves.why: A similar black bottle silhouette is visible, but it is so small that the original visible details are not preserved clearly.

must_haves.item: The bottle stands on a light stone kitchen counter rather than the original wooden table.
must_haves.why: The light stone counter is present, but the bottle floats far above it.

must_haves.item: A tidy modern kitchen is visible behind the bottle.
must_haves.why: Modern pale cabinetry, a sink, and neatly arranged kitchen accessories are visible.

must_haves.item: The bottle has clean edges and a believable contact shadow, without appearing to float.
must_haves.why: The bottle visibly floats against an upper cabinet and has no contact shadow.

must_haves.item: The output is square and has no added text.
must_haves.why: The image is square and no added text is visible.
